## [operator-attested] Stress evidence for the "passes repeatedly under load locally" criterion

Run against the LANDED tree (Gerrit change 1611, merged), not a local working copy:

    tree:  c0bb6dccd0d142fceb9dbdf5c539229d8d86cbb4   (origin/main, contains change 1611)
    host:  darwin arm64, python 3.12, worktree venv

### 60 consecutive runs of the previously-flaking test

    $ for i in $(seq 1 60); do
        python -m pytest \
          tests/interfaces/store/test_git_contention_9305.py::test_concurrent_processes_through_seam_both_succeed \
          -q -p no:cacheprovider
      done

    start: 2026-08-12T03:17:26Z
    end:   2026-08-12T03:18:11Z
    consecutive runs: pass=60 fail=0

### Under `-n 4` xdist

    $ python -m pytest tests/interfaces/store/test_git_contention_9305.py \
        -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 4 --dist worksteal
    9 passed in 4.95s

### Baseline for comparison (BEFORE the fix, same host)

The same single test on the pre-fix tree failed **1 in 25** runs in one sweep, and did not
reproduce in a following 40-run sweep — i.e. an intermittent ~1/25-1/65, which is what made it
a CI flake rather than a hard failure. 60 consecutive green runs post-fix is therefore a
meaningful signal, and it is corroborated by the mechanism proof rather than resting on the
run count alone:

### Direct proof the mechanism is gone (stronger than the run count)

The deterministic interleaving that produced the failure was replayed through the real seam
before and after the change.

BEFORE — bare whole-index commit:

    alpha add rc=0 / beta add rc=0 / alpha commit rc=0 / beta commit rc=1
    beta commit stderr=''
    beta commit stdout='On branch main\nnothing to commit, working tree clean\n'
    git log: alpha, seed          alpha in log: True   beta in log: False

AFTER — each writer commits its own pathspec:

    alpha add rc=0 / beta add rc=0 / alpha commit rc=0 / beta commit rc=0
    git log: beta, alpha, seed    alpha in log: True   beta in log: True
    HEAD contents: beta.txt | 1 +      (each commit carries only its own file)

The exact interleaving that used to lose a writer now succeeds, so the failure mode is
eliminated by construction and not merely unobserved.

### Whole-suite regression check

    $ python -m pytest -m "not integration and not external" -n 4 --dist worksteal \
        --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread
    11862 passed, 57 skipped, 39 warnings in 651.51s

Also: Gerrit change 1611 carries `Verified +1` (full CI matrix: ubuntu py3.11/py3.12 and
macos py3.13) and `LLM-Review +1`, and merged.
